lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: The clinic lost two patients last night. Same blue drug, same Halvane seal. Open the marked crates. Let's find where it came from.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Blue glass. Same vials we picked up outside the clinic. Get a look at the rest.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: That's a pistol grip. Under the medicine tray. What else is in there?

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: A whole case of crystal sidearms. That stamp on the lid... the Ash Legion took the south bridge with guns like these.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Dask packed it. Perrin sold it. Rooke signed it out. Get their ledger cores. I want to know who keeps the money.

lines.speaker: Dask
lines.text: Put that down. I stamped every piece in that crate. I know when one's missing.

lines.speaker: Perrin
lines.text: I sell to whoever clears the invoice. You got a purchase order?

lines.speaker: Dask
lines.text: Ask Perrin how a box of my work pays for a captain's house.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: One core. Two more signatures on every transfer.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: Seal it. Nobody walks out of here with a core.

lines.speaker: Perrin
lines.text: Read the buyer column. The Legion paid on Friday. On Saturday the bridge fell.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Two. One more and we know all of it.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: Take it. You will not reach the lift.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: That is all three. Forget the depot: get the cores to the cargo lift. I am bringing it down.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: All posts: lock it down. They are carrying the cores.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Lift is coming. Half a minute. Do not let them pull you off it.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Look at the deposits. The drug money bought the guns. Every Legion payment went back to one account.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Last core's got a voice memo. I'll play it.

lines.speaker: Arden (recording)
lines.text: I signed for those crates. Come to the vault. You deserve to ask me why.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Arden? I... I've heard him call roll since I was six.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: I let the first shipment through. Crane promised medicine for Saltmarch. By the time I saw the guns, she'd put my name on every crate.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: You still drop your guard after the third cut. I never could fix that.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: Enough. Take my seal. Check my story yourself.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: Crane took a cut on every vial and every gun. Her next stop is Saltmarch. The people there kept the receipts.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: I'll get the ledger out. You get to those witnesses before Crane does.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Saltmarch kept the original receipts. Crane's on her way with a warrant to seize them. We need the witnesses alive.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Get inside before their wardens do. And go easy: whoever is in there will take you for wardens.

lines.speaker: Defender
lines.text: Wardens at the lock! Hold them!

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: They stand down when they are beaten. Let them.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: You will not take one of us. Not one.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: You had a clear shot. Why'd you let me get back up?

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Tell him about the blue glass. Show him Arden's seal.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: My daughter counted jars on the late shift. When a case broke, Crane docked her pay. Here. That's her handwriting.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: I... I sent her name to the court this morning. I thought they'd protect her. Crane signed for the file.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: She's in the infirmary. Ring all three bells. Our people know the way out when they hear them.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Warden signatures at the outer lock. They are already in the yard.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: They hear it. The first of them are on the stairs.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: One more, and every soul in Saltmarch is moving.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: More of them, and a marksman. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: That is all of them. To the chapel: the tunnel door is behind the altar.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: I used to make Crane empty her pockets before practice. Loose change everywhere. I should've asked whose it was.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: A hundred people are on those stairs. Hold this door with me.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: A second squad through the commons. Wardens and a marksman.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: My girl's through. She's still got her book. You hear that? We've got her out.

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: Hand over the book. You can walk out with your teacher. I'll even pay you what I paid the Legion.

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: What do you think kept my garrison fed? Those little blue bottles paid us for years!

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: Call them off... please. My wardens will stand down.

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: The account key's in my coat. Take it. Just let me stand when they come for me.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: The council put Saltmarch under your command. My company will serve here, if you'll have us.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Crane's in custody. First supply train just called in. Our people at the bridge finally have something to defend it with.
